name: stopify
description: Premium e-commerce platform with AI customer service

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
